summary: Williams' 1982 arcade game and its many official home conversions and compilations.

entries.title: Joust
entries.definitive_edition: Arcade Joust through Midway Arcade Origins

emulation.emulator: Midway Arcade Origins; MAME for a legally dumped board set
emulation.notes: Use the official Xbox compilation first. MAME or original PCB capture is the comparison ceiling, not a content-mop-up route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade logic with low-latency, aspect-correct output.

primary.why: Midway Arcade Origins contains the 1982 Williams arcade game and remains sold for Xbox One and Series consoles. It is the cleanest current official purchase route to the arcade version, with local play and modern display output.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Xbox store release on Xbox One or Series hardware. Preserve the original aspect ratio and avoid display stretching; use an original arcade board or a legally dumped MAME set only for latency and emulation comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Williams arcade hardware and content authority.
all_releases.reason: primary reference: the version later compilations preserve.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced home-port-exclusive content requires another run; the goal is faithful access to the arcade original.

entries.remaster_caveats: The many Atari, computer, Nintendo, and handheld editions are conversions, not enhanced replacements. Keep the arcade aspect ratio and do not stretch the image.
